verdict.rationale: GitBook supports headless/automated workflows via Git Sync (push-based automation with GitHub/GitLab, docs-4/docs-27), a documented CLI (docs-28), and a live, auth-gated organization-level MCP server for programmatic content operations (gitbook-probe-rt-3), which together enable CI-style automation. However, community evidence notes the GitBook CLI was at one point 'no longer under active development' (gitbook-comm-17), and there is no explicit first-party documentation of a dedicated CI/CD pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Action) — missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation/examples, confirmation that the current CLI is actively maintained, and independent hands-on verification of automated CI runs.
